messages.content: তুমি কি মনে করো manush der personality change hoy naki same thake life bhor?
Honestly core traits kichuta stable thake, kintu expression change hoy experience er sathe - shompurno same thaka impossible mone hoy।
tumi nijer modhhe ki change dekhecho recent e?
Actually beshi patience develop hoyeche mone hoy, age quickly frustrated hoye jetam choto jinis e - ekhon beshi calm thakte pari।
eta ki kono specific ghotona theke hoyeche naki gradually?
Gradually actually, kono ekta single moment na - kintu bhable mone hoy shomoy er sathe manush ke choto choto lesson accumulate kore change kore dey।
